speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. To better understand your condition, please describe the appearance of the rash on your palms—does it appear scaly, blistered, or erythematous? Additionally, how long have you been experiencing these numbness and tingling sensations?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Cutaneous Leishmaniasis with associated neuropathy (likely secondary to chronic scratching or direct nerve involvement) due to exposure on a rice farm. Please confirm if you have visited endemic areas for Leishmania. REQUEST TEST: Blood smear for Leishmania amastigotes, Skin biopsy.
